mines.mine_notes: Open-pit polymetallic unit, Santa Bárbara de Carhuacayán, Junín (182 km east of Lima); operating since April 2014. Río Pallanga underground mine in temporary suspension since December 2015. Last production blast at the Alpamarca pit in December 2025 (end of pit life per Dec-2024 reserve update); 2025 feed: 569 kt from pit + 401 kt stockpiles + 33 kt old tailings DR-01. Plant capacity 2,500 tpd; recoveries 75.7% Zn, 85.7% Pb, 82.2% Ag. 2025 production approx: 4.5 kt Zn (-9.2%), 3.5 kt Pb (-18.6%), 0.2 kt Cu, 0.7 Moz Ag (-12.4%). Unit in transition to the Romina project.

mines.mine_notes: Growth project near Alpamarca (continuity of the Alpamarca unit; integrates Puagjanca, Andrea-Adriana, Santa and Romina Central deposits).
